jobs.name: Biweekly vendor changelog digest
jobs.prompt: Every two weeks, research official release notes, changelog pages, product-update blogs, and publicly available RSS/status feeds for these 19 platforms: Adobe Acrobat / Adobe DC, AnyDesk, Canva, ChatGPT Business, Claude, ClickUp, Cognito Forms, Easy Llama, Freshservice, GitBook, Google Workspace, Grasshopper, Group Travel Video, HubSpot, Microsoft 365, NinjaOne MDM, ScribeHow, Travefy, and WeTravel. Report only genuinely new items since the prior digest; deduplicate repeated announcements. Prefer official vendor sources and include a source URL for every item. Separate product/feature changes from service-status incidents. Keep the digest concise: platform, date, what changed, business relevance, and source. If no public update or reliable source is found for a platform, omit it rather than guessing. Clearly state when no material updates were found.
